rules.law: New York Alcoholic Beverage Control Law §64(7)
rules.lead: No retail license for on-premises consumption shall be granted for any premises which shall be
rules.a: on the same street or avenue and within two hundred feet of a building occupied exclusively as a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship
rules.b: in a city, town or village having a population of twenty thousand or more within five hundred feet of three or more existing premises licensed and operating pursuant to this section and sections sixty-four-a, sixty-four-b, sixty-four-c, and/or sixty-four-d of this article
rules.c: the measurements in paragraphs (a) and (b) of this subdivision are to be taken in straight lines from the center of the nearest entrance of the premises sought to be licensed to the center of the nearest entrance of such school, church, synagogue or other place of worship or to the center of the nearest entrance of each such premises licensed and operating pursuant to this section and sections sixty-four-a, sixty-four-b, sixty-four-c, and/or sixty-four-d of this article

sla_classes.label: SLA license type and class definitions

cannabis_rules.a: No premises with a license issued pursuant to this section, or section sixty-eight-a of this article, or section seventy-three of this article that allows for the retail sale of adult-use cannabis, shall be located on the same street and within five hundred feet of a building containing a school.
cannabis_rules.b: No premises with a license issued pursuant to this section, or section sixty-eight-a of this article, or section seventy-three of this article that allows for the retail sale of adult-use cannabis, shall be located on the same street and within two hundred feet of a building exclusively occupied as a house of worship.
cannabis_rules.c: The measurements in paragraphs (a) and (b) of this subdivision are to be taken in straight lines from the center of the nearest entrance of the premises sought to be licensed to the center of the nearest entrance of such school or house of worship.
cannabis_rules.f: No renewal of a license shall be denied because of the restrictions in paragraphs (a) or (b) of this subdivision.

schools_worship.measure: straight line between building points (address page point; FacDB facility point; PLUTO lot point; SLA license point), projected to EPSG:2263 feet with DuckDB spatial; not entrance to entrance
schools_worship.class_labels: PLUTO DATA DICTIONARY August 2026 (26v2), M. CHURCHES, SYNAGOGUES, ETC.
schools_worship.same_street: the facility's listed street name (house number and floor, suite or unit text removed, normalized like page addresses) equals one of the page's listed street names

page_points.rule: GeoSearch PAD point when the page's geocode is matched; else the average of the records' own points. A page whose GeoSearch point is outside both districts keeps its district but gets no proximity facts.

address_geocode.rule: first the City's normalized PAD file (the file GeoSearch is built from) in DuckDB: same house number, normalized street and borough, with cleanup readings (padmatch.candidates); readings that can land on the wrong building must be within 1000 ft of the records' own point. Then GeoSearch for the rest: same house number, street and borough; confidence >= 0.8; accuracy point. Placeholder BINs (x000000) are never used as keys
